name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Reroute.kilian_relations_iff
title: Kilian re-randomization preserves the linear relations among prefix rows
statement: Over a field, if the prefix rows of two encodings satisfy XB x = XA x * T for every prefix x with T invertible, then for every coefficient vector c, sum_x c x XA x = 0 iff sum_x c x XB x = 0.
